name: job-application-generator
description: Small, reusable CV generator: validates a YAML dataset and renders a static website.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate.mjs data/cv.yaml data/cv.example.yaml data/profiles data/pages data/applications tests/fixtures/profiles tests/fixtures/pages tests/fixtures/applications
scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs --data data/cv.yaml --profiles data/profiles --pages data/pages --applications data/applications --out dist
scripts.build:example: node scripts/build.mjs --data data/cv.example.yaml --profiles tests/fixtures/profiles --pages tests/fixtures/pages --applications tests/fixtures/applications --out dist-example
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run build && npm test
